title: Zero relative Hamming distance implies equality
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty set, let $C$ be a type with decidable equality, and let $f,g:D\\to C$. If the number of inputs on which $f$ and $g$ differ, divided by the cardinality of $D$, is zero, then $f=g$.
hypotheses_covered: The domain is finite and nonempty
$f,g$ are functions from the domain to the codomain
Their relative Hamming distance is zero
